title: Whether all life is sentient is unresolved

statements.text: The enactive conception of life as value-driven does not settle whether all life is sentient: a conceptual and inferential gap remains between responsiveness to value and felt, hedonic valence. The case for restricting sentience to animals is also inconclusive, and Thompson no longer finds compelling the reasons he gave in Mind in Life for that restriction.
